subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The teacher emphasized the importance of _________ correct grammar and punctuation in our writing.
solution:
The correct answer is '**using**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 

• The verb "**using**" is the present participle form of the verb "**use**." 

• In this sentence, "**using**" is appropriate because it fits grammatically within the phrase "the importance of using correct grammar."
